question: Which of the following states initiated Mukhyamantri Digital Seva Yojana for women empowerment through increasing digital reach of women by providing 3 years internet services (data) along with smart phones in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Mukhyamantri Digital Seva Yojana** was launched by the **Government of Rajasthan** in **2022**.
 
• This scheme aims to **empower women** by increasing their **digital reach**.
 
• Under this initiative, women are provided with **smartphones** and **3 years of internet services (data)**.
 
• The objective is to **bridge the digital divide** and ensure that women have access to **digital resources**.
 
• This scheme is part of broader efforts to **enhance digital literacy** and **connectivity** among women in Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Kerala** is known for its **high literacy rate** and **advanced healthcare system**.
 
• The state has a strong focus on **education** and **social welfare**.
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** is famous for its **hilly terrain** and **tourism** industry.
 
• The state has several initiatives aimed at promoting **sustainable development** and **environmental conservation**.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** is known for its **agriculture** and **information technology** sectors.
 
• The state has been implementing various schemes to **boost digital literacy** and **connectivity** among its residents.
